name: create_asset_upload
description: Begin a direct-to-S3 upload. Returns an asset_id and a presigned upload_url; PUT the file bytes to upload_url, then call POST /v3/assets/{asset_id}/complete. Unlike POST /v3/assets (which proxies the bytes), this never sends the file through the API.

filename.description: Original filename for reference/metadata. The stored object's extension is derived from content_type.
filename.title: Filename

contentType.description: Declared MIME type (e.g. 'video/mp4'). Verified against the stored bytes at completion.
contentType.title: Contenttype

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the file. Signed into the upload URL so it cannot be exceeded.
sizeBytes.title: Sizebytes

checksumSha256.description: Optional SHA256 of the file as hex. When provided, S3 enforces it on upload.
checksumSha256.title: Checksumsha256
